I own a Thrustmaster T248R: is $300 worth spending on it? On PS5, nothing up to $600 in our catalog raises its rig score; the next real step is $910 (Logitech G RS50 with G PRO pedals, 67 to 80). On PC, the Thrustmaster T-LCM Pedals at about $239 take it from 67 to 74 and you keep the wheel. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #ps5 #thrustmaster

The T248R's next step, on PS5 and on PC: https://roomracer.com/upgrade/thrustmaster-t248r?src=yt-upgrade
title: Thrustmaster T248R: is $300 worth spending on it? On PS5, keep your money
